instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for CedarVale Award Review: The project manages grant application intake, eligibility review, proposal review, budget review, and final award decisions. Applicants submit application packages; Program Officers check eligibility; eligible applications go to two Reviewers; Reviewers add comments; Finance Officers review proposed budgets only after proposal reviews are complete; Award Approvers record final decisions; and approved applicants receive notices. It is undecided which criteria determine eligibility, who selects the two Reviewers, who revises an unacceptable budget, which notice channel is used, and how quickly the notice must be sent. One stakeholder says applicants should see reviewer comments immediately, while another says comments must remain hidden until the final decision is recorded.

output.summary: CedarVale Award Review manages grant application intake, eligibility review, proposal review, budget review, and final award decisions. Applicants, Program Officers, Reviewers, Finance Officers, and Award Approvers participate in submission, review, decision recording, and approval notification. Several responsibilities and notice details remain undecided, and the timing of applicant access to reviewer comments is conflicting.
output.primary_goal: Manage grant application intake, eligibility review, proposal review, budget review, and final award decisions.
key_capabilities: Route eligible applications to two Reviewers.
Review proposed budgets only after proposal reviews are complete.
unresolved_points: The role that selects the two Reviewers is undecided.
The actor responsible for revising an unacceptable budget is undecided.
The approval notice channel and maximum delivery time are undecided.
Stakeholders conflict on when applicants may view reviewer comments.
